description: Welcome to our luxurious 4-bedroom apartment, nestled in close proximity to the iconic Champs-Élysées.The spaceThis charming 175sqm look-a-like penthouse apartment, located on the 6th floor( elevator until the 5th floor), offers a cozy and comfortable living space. It is fully equipped with all the essentials you'll need for a comfortable stay. Sumptuous living space: indulge in the expansive living area adorned with plush furnishings, creating an inviting ambiance for relaxation and entertainment. The sophisticated decor, curated art pieces, and panoramic views add to the overall grandeur of the space.Gourmet kitchen: the state-of-the-art kitchen is a haven for culinary enthusiasts, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and sleek countertops. Whether you're preparing a casual meal or hosting a lavish dinner, this kitchen is a delight for any discerning chef.Luxurious bedrooms: retreat to each of the four opulent bedrooms, each meticulously designed for ultimate comfort. Lavish furnishings, ample storage, and en-suite bathrooms contribute to the indulgent atmosphere, ensuring a restful sanctuary after a day of exploring the City of Lights.Designer Bathrooms: pamper yourself in the designer bathrooms featuring modern fixtures, marble accents, and luxurious amenities. The perfect blend of functionality and elegance enhances your daily routine, providing a spa-like experience.Guest accessYou will have access to the entire apartment just for yourself, ideal to feel at home away from home.Careful, there is an elevator but it stops on the 5th floor, you need to take stairs for the last floor.Other things to noteThis booking is protected with coverage for lost luggage and emergency medical expenses, provided by Travel Support with claim upto 750 Euros (T&C Applies).
